question: Where can I find a café in the northeast direction from West End Park, Queensbury, NY within 140 kilometers?
sql: WITH park_location AS ( SELECT pa.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS pa WHERE pa.park_name ILIKE '%West End Park%' AND ST_Intersects( pa.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Queensbury%' LIMIT 1) ) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, park_location AS pl WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, pl.geom::geography, 140000) -- 140 kilometers = 140000 meters AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(pl.geom), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
